csv_project_name: AE for Dosewallips River Habitat Restoration Powerlines
csv_scope_of_work: Jefferson County, hereafter referred to as the Agency, is seeking a multi-disciplined engineering firm to provide civil and structural engineering, surveying, geotechnical engineering, geology, hydrology and hydraulic analysis, and environmental assessments and permitting (Exhibit A) to develop a final habitat restoration design and associated permits for a portion of the Dosewallips River and floodplain (River Mile 1.0 to 2.0) upstream of the community of Brinnon, WA. In portions of the Powerlines Reach, located between River Mile (RM) 1.0 and 3.3, the main channel exhibits a meandering pool-riffle channel morphology with deep pools at the outside of meander bends separated by steeper riffles. However, within the subject segment, RM 1.0 and 2.0, are broad, poorly sorted gravel bars intersected by a series of unstable braided channels.
csv_disciplines_requested: Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Habitat Restoration/Wetlands Restoration
